CrisisEvent.CrisisDescription: Winter Storm Sasha was a crippling, large and major winter and ice storm that had widespread impacts across the United States, Northern Mexico, and parts of Canada from January 13 to 17, 2023.
Hurricane Isadora, a Category 5 storm, devastated the Gulf Coast, with winds over 160 mph.
